parent_catalogs.CW-All: Toni et al. (2025), AMICO group catalog
parent_catalogs.CW-HCG: Hasinger et al. (in prep.), Hickson compact-group catalog

scope_note: Compact release: individually X-ray-detected (SNR >= 2.0) groups only, with exactly the columns shown in Paper I Table A.1/A.2 (ID, RA, Dec, z, SNR, flux, L_X, T_X, and the Leroy et al. 2026 luminosity-based M200/R500/R200). Does not include non-detections/upper limits, background diagnostics, binned/stacking columns, the temperature-based mass alternative, or richness/provenance columns.
